# Audit Angel AI

> AI clinical audit software for NHS and UK healthcare providers. Audit Angel AI audits 100% of consultations and care notes against NICE, RCGP and CQC standards instead of a small manual sample. Clinicians make every decision.

Audit Angel AI is built by Codex Software Solutions Ltd (company number 09712933, Cirencester, UK), the team behind the Audit Angel clinical audit platform (https://audit-angel.co.uk). Contact: contact@audit-angel.co.uk.

## Features
- AI Bulk Audit: import a consultation export (EMIS Web, SystmOne, Adastra or a care system CSV) and the AI audits every case. Each case gets a status (compliant, needs review, high risk), the reason, and the standard it was checked against. A report groups findings by audit area and turns them into tasks.
- AI Co-Auditor: when a clinician audits a case by hand, the AI suggests a score for each audit question with the supporting sentence from the note. The auditor accepts or changes every score; there is no "accept all". Suggestions, final scores and overrides are logged.
- Patient data is anonymised at the point of data import: identifiers are removed before records are stored or seen by any AI.
- Agreement between AI and clinician review is measured on every run and is over 95%.
- Typical audit areas: safety-netting, antibiotic prescribing (NICE NG84), high-risk drug monitoring, red flags and escalation, consent and documentation.

## Who it is for
Clinical directors and clinical governance leads at GP federations and PCNs, urgent care, NHS 111 and out-of-hours providers, care home and home care groups, and private or online clinics in the UK.

## Security and assurance
ISO/IEC 27001 (UKAS accredited), Cyber Essentials, NHS DSPT "Standards met", DCB0129 clinical safety case, UK data residency.
